_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Churchill's Iron Curtain speech
events.desc: Churchill speaks at Fulton, Missouri.

events.label: Truman Doctrine
events.desc: Truman asks Congress for aid to Greece and Turkey.

events.label: Marshall Plan enacted
events.desc: The United States funds the recovery of western Europe.

events.label: Berlin Blockade begins
events.desc: The Soviet Union cuts land routes to West Berlin; the airlift supplies the city until May 1949.

events.label: North Atlantic Treaty signed
events.desc: Twelve states found NATO.

events.label: First Soviet atomic bomb test
events.desc: The test at Semipalatinsk ends the American nuclear monopoly.

events.label: People's Republic of China proclaimed
events.wiki: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China
events.desc: Mao Zedong proclaims the new state in Beijing.

events.label: Korean War begins
events.desc: North Korea invades the South; an armistice is signed in July 1953.

events.label: Death of Stalin
events.wiki: Death and state funeral of Joseph Stalin
events.desc: Stalin dies at his dacha near Moscow.

events.label: Warsaw Pact signed
events.desc: The Soviet Union and seven allies form a military alliance.

events.label: Hungarian Revolution
events.desc: The uprising is crushed by Soviet troops in November.

events.label: Sputnik 1 launched
events.desc: The first artificial satellite.

events.label: Cuban Revolution triumphs
events.desc: Batista flees Cuba and Castro's forces take power.

events.label: Yuri Gagarin orbits the Earth
events.desc: The first human spaceflight.

events.label: Berlin Wall built
events.desc: East Germany closes the border around West Berlin.

events.label: Cuban Missile Crisis
events.desc: Thirteen days of confrontation over Soviet missiles in Cuba.

events.label: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty
events.desc: The United States, the Soviet Union and Britain ban tests in the atmosphere, space and under water.

events.label: Gulf of Tonkin Resolution
events.desc: Congress authorises military action in Vietnam.

events.label: Warsaw Pact invasion of Czechoslovakia
events.desc: Soviet-led forces end the Prague Spring.

events.label: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.desc: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the Moon.

events.label: Nixon visits China
events.wiki: 1972 visit by Richard Nixon to China
events.desc: The first visit by a US president to the People's Republic.

events.label: SALT I and the ABM Treaty signed
events.desc: The first agreements limiting strategic nuclear arms.

events.label: Fall of Saigon
events.desc: North Vietnamese forces take the southern capital; the Vietnam War ends.

events.label: Helsinki Accords
events.desc: Thirty-five states sign the Final Act of the Conference on Security and Co-operation in Europe.

events.label: Soviet invasion of Afghanistan
events.desc: Soviet forces enter Afghanistan; they withdraw in 1989.

events.label: Gdańsk Agreement; Solidarity founded
events.desc: Striking shipyard workers win the right to an independent trade union.

events.label: Gorbachev becomes Soviet leader
events.desc: The Politburo chooses Gorbachev as General Secretary.

events.label: Chernobyl disaster
events.desc: A reactor explodes at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Soviet Ukraine.

events.label: INF Treaty signed
events.desc: Reagan and Gorbachev agree to eliminate intermediate-range missiles.
